summary: Learn Excel-based rent roll, occupancy, arrears and property cost analysis. Explore the five-day foundation course and review the outline.
lede: Property data analytics helps property managers, asset officers and real estate analysts turn tenancy and building records into clear operating reports. Through Excel exercises, learners validate rent-roll data, calculate occupancy and rent-collection measures, and build arrears, lease-expiry and cost views. They also compare property trends and present exceptions through portfolio dashboards, with attention to data quality and documented assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who work directly with property, tenancy, maintenance or asset-performance information and need to report findings clearly.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with property or tenancy records is useful. Basic spreadsheet familiarity is expected; no coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for the practical exercises.
